name: Avatar
description: Displays a user's profile image with an initials fallback when the image is unavailable or fails to load. Supports multiple sizes and two shapes.

notes: The img element uses the name prop as its alt text for screen reader identification.
When rendering initials (no src or image error), the container has role=img and aria-label set to the name prop.
Image load errors are handled via onError to fall back to initials gracefully.

src.description: URL of the avatar image. When absent or on load failure, initials are shown.

name.description: Full name of the person. Used as alt text for the image and as the source for initials. Required.

size.description: Controls the rendered dimensions via CSS custom properties.

shape.description: Circle uses radius-component-full; square uses radius-component-md.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Always provide the name prop — it drives both the alt text and initials.
Use circle shape for person-oriented contexts (profiles, comments).
Use square shape for organisation or brand avatars.
dont: Do not use avatar without the name prop.
Do not rely on the image alone to identify a person — the initials fallback must be meaningful.
Do not scale avatars with inline styles — use the size prop.
